title: Glorification
definition: Glorification is the final completion of salvation when believers are fully conformed to Christ and freed from sin forever.
summary: God's saving work will not remain unfinished. Believers will be raised, perfected, and made like Christ in glory.
christFocus: Christ's resurrection guarantees the future glory of His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's saving work will not remain unfinished. Believers will be raised, perfected, and made like Christ in glory.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
